stories.title: Further BBC cuts could undermine funding model, union leader warns
stories.summary: A trade union leader has warned more cost-saving measures could prompt Scots to question why they pay the licence fee.

stories.title: Former hunt master convicted of illegal fox hunting
stories.summary: Claire Bellamy, of Lauderdale Hunt, has been banned from owning or keeping dogs for 10 years.

stories.title: Couple deny embezzling £138,000 from dying boy's fundraiser
stories.summary: It is alleged they embezzled the money while acting as administrators of a GoFundMe set up for Nathaniel Nabena.

stories.title: US military aircraft landed at Prestwick Airport after leaving English base
stories.summary: The departures come weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford airbase over a suspected Iran-linked security incident.

stories.title: Aberdeen flat fire treated as deliberate
stories.summary: One person received treatment at the scene after emergency services were called to Richmond Walk.

stories.title: Amber alert as Scotland faces blood donation shortages
stories.summary: An amber alert has been issued after stockpiles of blood fell below target several times in recent months

stories.title: Edinburgh Academy pupils suffered decades of 'dreadful abuse'
stories.summary: A report from the Scottish Child Abuse Inquiry says the school focused on protecting its reputation and ignored complaints.

stories.title: Fourth person charged in connection with pro-Palestinian Action rally
stories.summary: The woman is the fourth person charged over the protest outside the US Consulate building in Edinburgh.

stories.title: Peter Pan mansion cafe forced to close after just over a year
stories.summary: The site at Moat Brae in Dumfries faced financial pressures and "ongoing difficulties behind the scenes".

stories.title: Patch of one of UK's rarest flowers saved from falling into the sea
stories.summary: The tiny one-flowered wintergreens were rescued from an area of eroded coastline at Culbin Sands.

stories.title: 'I look after history in a fantastic place' - meet the UK's youngest lighthouse keeper
stories.summary: Jeri Cormack is tasked with maintaining three historic lighthouses in Caithness on the edge of the British mainland.

stories.title: Motherwell feels like a 'failed project', say residents frustrated by closures
stories.summary: A council decision to demolish Motherwell Concert Hall is the latest in a long line of culture and leisure closures in the town.
